ontology.note: The semantic contract belongs to the ruleset, which declares its own output vocabulary and basis; do not infer one from this widget.

changes.description: Replaces Derive a value, which is retired (experiment 188, stage 5). Settings are declared in the rules dialog: a name, a value and a unit, so a condition can compare against a threshold that is changed without rewriting a rule. Only the columns the rules read must state a unit; a sum or difference of two columns in different units is refused while the rule is written. A category typed in a condition is now the term the record's value becomes: before, it was a quoted string no record could equal, so a condition on a category never held. The Inspector of a step whose rules are written here lists its input, as every step does. A step after it is offered the columns and values the rules add. A saved Derive a value step opens as an Apply ruleset step with the same rule, stamped as migrated.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists, and the Validation Lab checks this widget exhaustively rather than by sample -- check 23 enumerates the complete input space of all three bundled rulesets, 46 cells, reproducing every conclusion with an independent decision table and verifying the emitted receipt. That is evidence about the rulesets and about this widget's four stages; it does not certify the widget independently, and it says nothing about whether any threshold is right.
